# Norvia Labs

> Norvia Labs is an open-source lab exploring developer tools and infrastructure for agentic software engineering. The active project is Forge, a terminal-native AI coding environment.

Norvia Labs builds focused tools for how software gets built, operated, and governed when AI agents become part of the engineering stack. Experiments are MIT licensed and built in the open. The lab is not a services company.

## Docs

- [About](https://norvialabs.com/about/): The lab's thesis, principles, and how experiments are built and shipped
- [Experiments](https://norvialabs.com/experiments/): Full portfolio of open-source experiments and queued ideas
- [Contact](https://norvialabs.com/contact/): Open-source collaboration, project discussion, and contributions

## Projects

- [Forge](https://forge.norvialabs.com/): Terminal-native AI coding environment. Brings the agent, editor, repository navigation, shell, diffs, approvals, and durable sessions into one workspace. Rust. Active — [source](https://github.com/norvialabs/forge) · [releases](https://github.com/norvialabs/forge/releases)
- Guard: Governance and execution controls for agent-accessible tools and infrastructure. Queued experiment
- Contract: Explicit contracts for systems and APIs used by agents. Queued experiment
- Route: Routing infrastructure for agent and model workloads. Queued experiment
- Audit: Auditable records of agent actions and decisions. Queued experiment
